_comment: EXAMPLE — deliberate bun → Node substitution. Copy these `scripts` + `devDependencies` into fw's package.json (or take them as a model) to develop 100% under Node, without bun. `types:registry*`/`types:audit`/`prebuild*`/`build:standalone` are wired through Node's own module resolution (`import('@awacloud/tool-fw-{bundler,codegen}/<entry>').then(m => m.runCli(...))`), same as the bun-default profile's resolved node form — this profile's own devDependencies make that resolve locally, so no relative path is needed. `build:parseresult`/`build:aot` still target `index.js` explicitly (the isMainModule guard does not fire on `node <dir>`). Builds via the esbuild backend (Node). NB: this profile commits the Node toolchain as devDependencies, unlike the lean bun default.

scripts.docs:api: rm -rf dist/types && npm run types && node integrations/typedoc/categorize.js && typedoc --options integrations/typedoc/typedoc.json
